profile_text.body:
Janitor AI operates a platform at janitorai.com that, according to its own site, enables users to build, share, and explore AI-driven interactive fiction and character experiences. The company describes itself as a space where creators can build immersive worlds and readers can engage with what it calls "living stories," positioning the platform at the intersection of human creativity and AI generation.

The site tracks one product under the Chat and General LLMs category, listed simply as Janitor AI, with a noted focus on persona-based chat and flagged for HR and appropriate-use risk. No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are held for the company at this time.
